name: Kawasaki GPz750 Turbo
engine: 738 cc air-cooled DOHC inline four, turbocharged, fuel injected
intro: Kawasaki's turbo bike, the fastest of the 80s turbo era. Fuel injection, a turbo and an oil system to check first.

H: The turbo is oiled by the engine. Check the feed and return lines and change the oil before the first start.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
